name: Premium Plankton Oil
headline: Premium Plankton Oil
description: Contains calanus oil — a source of a rare form of omega-3 from Arctic zooplankton. This fully natural product from the cold, clean waters of the North Atlantic delivers omega-3 and other lipids in the rare wax-ester form, plus astaxanthin, with 500 mg of calanus oil per capsule.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 3 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Calanus oil from marine zooplankton Zooca (Calanus finmarchicus), capsule (gelatin, glycerin, water), vitamin E (D-alpha-tocopherol) in sunflower oil.
